card.name: Linking words in overdose and stop-use instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or verbs such as 'and', 'or', 'contact', 'listed' right after an instruction to contact Poison Control or to discontinue a drug. Also fires on a space inside a journal citation.

modes.label: Poison help instructions
modes.description: The word 'contact', 'or' or 'listed' in overdose text that points to the Poison Help line or poison control centers.
modes.example: an overdose with STEGLUJAN, contact the Poison Help line (1-800-222-1222)<< or>> a medical toxicologist for additional overdos

modes.label: Stop the drug and act
modes.description: The word 'and' after 'discontinue [drug]' that leads into the next action.
modes.example: If paradoxical bronchospasm occurs, discontinue Fluticasone Furoate/Vilanterol ELLIPTA<< and>> institute alternative therapy.

modes.label: Citation spacing
modes.description: The space before page numbers in a journal reference.
modes.example: forms of co-crystals of a family of active pharmaceutical ingredients, CrystEngComm, 2012, 14 (7),<< >>2435 - 2
